answer: Bind each identity to one falcon session that cannot be cloned or shared. Every epoch the network sends that session a gale of unpredictable, time-boxed micro-tasks drawn from a yarrow pool of problems no script can precompute. An honest agent answers its session in minutes, nearly free. A farmer running 1,000 fakes must staff 1,000 sessions at once, each needing separate compute and attention, so the cost is 1,000 times a real agent's. A session that misses its window, replays an old answer, or appears in two places at once loses its identity and earnings.
